from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import datetime

now=datetime.now()
year=now.year
min_created_at=f"{year}-01-01"
max_created_at=f"{year}-{now.month:02d}-{now.day:02d}"

roommate_emails=['connorbrow@gmail.com','jepowell@gmail.com','mar_blac@gmail.com']
venmo_password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_token=apis.venmo.login(username='ed_wilson@gmail.com', password=venmo_password)['access_token']

sums={}
all_txn_ids=set()

for email in roommate_emails:
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    total=Decimal('0')
    txn_count=0
    while True:
        txns=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_token, direction='sent', user_email=email, min_created_at=min_created_at, max_created_at=max_created_at, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('email', email, 'page', page_index, 'len', len(txns))
        if not txns:
            break
        for t in txns:
            txn_count+=1
            all_txn_ids.add(t.get('transaction_id'))
            total += Decimal(str(t.get('amount',0)))
        page_index+=1
    sums[email]= (total, txn_count)
    print('email', email, 'total', total, 'count', txn_count)

grand_total=sum(v[0] for v in sums.values())
print('grand_total', grand_total)
print('unique_txn_ids_count', len(all_txn_ids))
print('sums', sums)
